name: Hochschule Worms Computer Center (RZ)
notes: University computer center in Worms; public pages identify the Computer Center/RZ and IT services. No public MW capacity found.

name: Hochschule Kaiserslautern Rechenzentrum - Campus Zweibrücken servicepoint
notes: HS Kaiserslautern lists its Rechenzentrum serving the Kaiserslautern, Pirmasens and Zweibrücken campuses and a campus Zweibrücken servicepoint. No public MW capacity found.

name: KÜS DATA Losheim am See data center
notes: KÜS announced its high-security/high-performance data center in Losheim am See had been commissioned; current KÜS business IT page advertises colocation/housing. No public MW capacity found.

name: INFOSERVE Saarbrücken data center
notes: INFOSERVE describes an ISO 27001-certified data center in Saarbrücken offering housing and managed services; saaris confirms Saarbrücken address. No public MW capacity found.

name: eurodata Saarbrücken data center
notes: eurodata identifies an ISO 27001 and ISO 22301-certified data center at Saarbrücken for Cloud Made in Germany services. No public MW capacity found.

name: IKS Saarbrücken municipal data center
developer: Informations- und Kommunikationsinstitut der Landeshauptstadt Saarbrücken
notes: City-owned IKS says its data center was modernized/new-built in 2016 and supports municipal tasks plus housing, hosting and cloud services. No public MW capacity found.

name: intersaar SB data center
notes: Data Center Map lists intersaar SB in Saarbrücken offering colocation and carrier services; intersaar advertises colocation among hosting/web services and PeeringDB confirms Saarbrücken address. No public MW capacity found.

name: Net-Build SAAR 1 data center
notes: Net-Build's official page describes SAAR 1 as a TÜV-certified colocation data center in Saarland with 100% availability since 2016. VSE video page says the high-performance data center was built in Saarwellingen. No public MW capacity found in primary source; third-party listings vary.

name: Deutsche Glasfaser Saarlouis / inexio data center
notes: Data Center Map lists Deutsche Glasfaser Saarlouis at Ludwig-Karl-Balzer-Allee 19 with professional data centre operation, TÜV level 3 and ISO certifications; Deutsche Glasfaser advertises colocation data centers. No public MW capacity found.

name: SKYWAY / Key-Systems DataCenter St. Ingbert
notes: Sources identify a Tier III data center in St. Ingbert offering colocation, vCloud, root/managed server and hosting services. No public MW capacity found.

name: NTT DATA Business Solutions Bautzen data center
developer: NTT DATA Business Solutions / itelligence AG
notes: NTT DATA Business Solutions describes its sustainable data center in Bautzen and notes a PV solar park has supplied the site since 2024; earlier official video covered the opening of the new Bautzen data center. No public MW capacity found.
